name: ipscanner-edge-guard-template
description: Edge guard that runs IPScanner Agentscan and IP Detection on every visitor, then annotates or blocks requests before they reach your origin.

IPSCANNER_API_KEY.description: Your IPScanner API key. Get a free key at [ipscanner.io](https://ipscanner.io). Without a key the Worker passes requests through unchecked.

MODE.description: `monitor` adds verdict headers only. `enforce` also blocks matching visitors with a 403.

ORIGIN_URL.description: Backend to forward to when the Worker runs on a custom domain or workers.dev. Leave empty when deployed on a route in front of an existing origin.

SITE_ID.description: Site ID from the [IPScanner dashboard](https://ipscanner.io/dashboard/sites), for example `site_...`. When set, mode and policy come from the dashboard. Leave empty to use `MODE` and the other vars.

POLICY_TTL.description: Seconds a site policy from the dashboard is reused before it is fetched again. Default `30`.
